A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type or stat bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with the title and a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-idjustassoonkissawookiee-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee]] (Decipher, printed; Decipher's [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes to: “Use 3 Force to place an opponent’s just deployed character, starship, vehicle, weapon, or device in opponent’s hand. On opponent’s next turn, that card (or one card of same title) may deploy for free.”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•I’d Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
